query:
WITH requested AS MATERIALIZED (
                                    SELECT DISTINCT message_id
                                    FROM unnest($2::text[]) AS ids(message_id)
                                )
                                SELECT
                                    locations.kind,
                                    locations.key,
                                    locations.folder_id,
                                    locations.message_id,
                                    locations.sequence,
                                    locations.received_at,
                                    locations.fingerprint,
                                    locations.document,
                                    locations.body
                                FROM requested
                                CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
                                    SELECT
                                        kind,
                                        key,
                                        folder_id,
                                        message_id,
                                        sequence,
                                        received_at,
                                        fingerprint,
                                        document,
                                        body
                                    FROM imap_state_entries
                                    WHERE link_id = $1
                                        AND kind = 'location'
                                        AND message_id = requested.message_id
                                    OFFSET 0
                                ) locations
